Kalundborg is a Danish municipality featured in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1]. The report assesses the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across Denmark, utilizing data from the Landspatientregistret (LPR) and the DanStroke registry [^src1]. 

Specifically, Kalundborg is evaluated under Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic apoplexy (stroke) through anticoagulant (AC) treatment [^src1]. The municipality's data on apoplexy events among atrial fibrillation patients is detailed on page 94 of the report [^src1]. By breaking down these metrics for all 98 Danish municipalities, the report serves as a critical tool for local quality development and benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system [^src1].
